title: FancyZones not working with multiple displays in combination with portable apps

judgment.rationale: Later evidence overturns the portable-only framing: installed Notepad++ also fails, while 100% scaling or removing the FHD display restores behavior. A mixed-DPI coordinate test is warranted.
evidence: The issue includes a video, diagnostic ZIP, affected app versions and seven follow-up comments.
Secondary-display windows resize but shift left; main-display behavior works.
Disabling drag transparency helps Notepad++ and KeePass but not PuTTY/KiTTY.
A four-display UHD/FHD setup works when the FHD screen is disabled; 100% scaling also restores arrangement.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the mixed-DPI coordinate and transparency matrix locally before changing conversion logic.

fix_assessment.rationale: A coordinate-conversion defect is plausible and repository-side, but no issue-linked implementation was found.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep zone placement and non-per-monitor-aware window coordinates consistent
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: placement or frame-offset calculations mix logical and physical coordinates for DPI-unaware/system-aware windows on mixed-scale secondary monitors; transparency may expose an additional branch.
plan: Trace the target RECT, monitor origin, DPI awareness and frame offsets in FancyZones WindowUtils.cpp for an affected secondary-monitor snap.
Identify the first coordinate mismatch and convert once at that boundary, preserving negative monitor origins and existing mixed-DPI bounds handling.
Add geometry coverage for unequal scaling, left/right secondary screens and non-per-monitor-aware windows; keep transparency-specific behavior separate if it has another cause.
verification: Snap KeePass, installed Notepad++ and PuTTY/KiTTY on each monitor with mixed scaling, then 100% scaling as a control.
Repeat drag transparency on/off and compare final window/frame rectangles with the zone.
Verify no regression for per-monitor-aware apps or monitors left of the primary.

confidence.rationale: Scaling and topology controls strongly implicate coordinate handling; the exact failing transform has not been instrumented.

issue_context.summary: Some windows snap with a horizontal offset on non-primary displays. Follow-up testing narrows this to mixed-display scaling rather than portable packaging alone.
known_information: Reported builds include 0.67.1, 0.68.0 and 0.72.0; current-build persistence is not established.
The supplied archive and video already support investigation.
Installed Notepad++ is affected too; elevation was already tried.
100% scaling and removing the FHD display are positive controls reported by the author.
inferences: Mixed-DPI awareness/conversion is better supported than a portable-app exclusion explanation.
PuTTY/KiTTY may retain an independent sizing constraint after the transparency workaround.
issue_context.analysis: Reproduce the reported control matrix before asking for more reporter evidence. The previous empty-assignee ownership claim has no basis.
initial_investigation: Read the full report and all seven comments; the paginated timeline contains no linked fix.

Inspected src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/WindowUtils.cpp at main commit 3d6827a53a579ba9bedcf8d4bbda21348d78cbdb, including DPI awareness checks, allMonitorsHaveSameDpiScaling, monitor bounds and inverse conversions.
Existing DPI guards mean a missing-conversion claim is not proven; trace values before editing.
No mixed-DPI UI test was executed and the diagnostic ZIP contents were not analyzed.

reproduce.title: Isolate scaling and transparency offsets
reproduce.version_requirement: Current supported build; historical comparison with reported 0.72.0 only in an isolated environment.
prerequisites: At least two monitors with different DPI scaling; KeePass, Notepad++ and PuTTY or KiTTY test windows.
Record and restore display settings and layouts after testing.
steps: 1. Configure unequal monitor scaling and zones on primary and secondary displays, including a display left of the primary.
2. Snap each test app to the same relative zone and record final window/frame and zone rectangles.
3. Repeat with drag transparency disabled and enabled.
4. Set all displays to 100% and repeat; then disable the differently scaled display and repeat.
5. Trace monitor origin, window DPI awareness and each coordinate conversion for the failing/control cases.
reproduce.expected_result: Final bounds match the selected zone regardless of monitor origin or scaling; app-imposed size limits are distinguished from coordinate offsets.
